criteria.c0: ask_site: Answer questions about Medusa Store from the site's own content: shipping times, returns and exchange policy, product categories, and product details (descriptions, materials, sizes, prices). Read-only. Returns matching content sections with source page paths — compose the answer from them. Not for cart or order state (use view_cart for the cart).
criteria.c1: search_products: Search the Medusa Store catalog (apparel: t-shirts, sweatshirts, sweatpants, shorts). Query by keyword and/or filter by category handle. Read-only (no cart or catalog changes) but shows the results in the page: a category filter opens that category's results page, a keyword search opens the store listing. Returns matching products with price, available option values (sizes/colors), and per-variant variant_id + stock — everything needed to choose a variant for add_to_cart.
criteria.c2: view_cart: Read the current shopping cart: items (product, variant, quantity, unit price, line total) and cart totals. Read-only; reports an empty cart honestly.
criteria.c3: complete_checkout: Complete guest checkout for the current cart in one step: sets the contact email and shipping/billing address, picks the shipping option and payment provider (automatically when the store offers exactly one of each, otherwise returns the choices so you can pass shipping_option_id / payment_provider_id), places the order, and returns the order confirmation (order id, display number, total, items). Use after add_to_cart; begin_checkout is not required.
criteria.c4: get_product: Get full details for one product by handle (e.g. 't-shirt') or id (prod_...): variants with prices and stock, option values, description, material. Navigates the page to that product so the user sees it. Use search_products first if the handle is unknown.
criteria.c5: add_to_cart: Add a product variant to the shopping cart by variant_id (take variant ids from search_products or get_product results). State-changing: the cart icon updates immediately. Returns what was added plus the updated cart contents and totals.
criteria.c6: update_cart: Edit the shopping cart: set a line item's quantity (action 'set_quantity' + quantity) or remove it (action 'remove'). line_id comes from view_cart or add_to_cart results. State-changing: the cart UI updates immediately. Returns the updated cart.
criteria.c7: begin_checkout: Start checkout for the current cart: navigates the page to the checkout flow with all cart items and totals preserved (the Medusa cart is the checkout session). No order is placed and no payment is taken by this tool — the user completes address, delivery and payment in the page. Returns the cart summary being checked out. To place the order use complete_checkout.
criteria.c8: __finish__: The task is complete. Report an answer supported by the observations.
criteria.c9: __abstain__: Stop because the task cannot be completed with the available actions or evidence.
